statement: The Da Yun (Luck Pillars) are the 10-year periods overlaid on the Four Pillars, each carrying its own Stem-Branch pair — the dynamic, unfolding dimension of a BaZi reading, layered on top of the fixed birth chart to show which themes are most active during a given decade of life.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard BaZi literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
